title: Rain cloud with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='cloudGrad' cx='45%' cy='35%' r='65%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#b8d4f0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#6fa8dc'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='dropGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#7fd4f5'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#3b9ecc'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Cloud body: overlapping circles -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='40' r='16' fill='url(#cloudGrad)'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='32' r='19' fill='url(#cloudGrad)'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='40' r='15' fill='url(#cloudGrad)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='47' rx='30' ry='14' fill='url(#cloudGrad)'/>

  <!-- Lighter belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='47' rx='24' ry='9' fill='#c9e2f7' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- Smiling face -->
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='37' r='3.2' fill='#1a2a4a'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='37' r='3.2' fill='#1a2a4a'/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx='43.2' cy='36' r='1.1' fill='#e8f4ff'/>
  <circle cx='59.2' cy='36' r='1.1' fill='#e8f4ff'/>

  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M40 45 Q50 55 60 45' stroke='#1a2a4a' stroke-width='2.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='44' rx='4' ry='2.6' fill='#f7a8c4' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='44' rx='4' ry='2.6' fill='#f7a8c4' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- Raindrops -->
  <g>
    <path d='M30 60 Q28 66 30 69 Q32 66 30 60Z' fill='url(#dropGrad)'/>
    <path d='M44 63 Q42 69 44 72 Q46 69 44 63Z' fill='url(#dropGrad)'/>
    <path d='M58 60 Q56 66 58 69 Q60 66 58 60Z' fill='url(#dropGrad)'/>
    <path d='M37 72 Q35 78 37 81 Q39 78 37 72Z' fill='url(#dropGrad)'/>
    <path d='M52 73 Q50 79 52 82 Q54 79 52 73Z' fill='url(#dropGrad)'/>
    <path d='M66 66 Q64 72 66 75 Q68 72 66 66Z' fill='url(#dropGrad)'/>
    <path d='M23 66 Q21 72 23 75 Q25 72 23 66Z' fill='url(#dropGrad)'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Small raindrop shine dots -->
  <circle cx='29.5' cy='64' r='0.8' fill='#d4f0ff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='43.5' cy='67' r='0.8' fill='#d4f0ff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='57.5' cy='64' r='0.8' fill='#d4f0ff' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
